{npc:Vascalir}, at the Rookgaard Academy, needs help stopping the orc shaman {creature:Kraknaknork}, who is terrorising Rookgaard. Over several missions you load catapults, kill rats, deliver herbs, steal silk from the {creature:Spider Queen}, save the library from fire, bring down the troll tunnel and prepare the invasion of the orc fortress. In the end you defeat Kraknaknork and get a full set of equipment to leave the island.
Character in Rookgaard, level 0–5 to start (level 2 recommended).
You have to finish before reaching **level 9**: from then on you can no longer continue the quest.
New characters start at **Mission 2** (Mission 1 is no longer available since the arrival of Dawnport).
Free space in your inventory: the {item:Heavy Stone|stones} of Mission 2 are very heavy.
Food and some potions (you receive several {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions} during the quest).
in a blue chest in the orc fortress
scattered across several boxes and chests
Experience in several missions (5 per catapult, 100, 50, 150 and 150 points).
Always talk to {npc:Vascalir} at the end of each mission: he is the one who gives you the reward and the next mission (say {key:mission} or answer {key:yes}).
Your quest log shows the progress of each mission (for example, how many rats you have killed so far).
Don't waste time levelling up: if you reach level 9 you can no longer finish the quest.
Put the {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions} on a hotkey before the final fight against {creature:Kraknaknork}.
If you are wounded before a mission, ask {npc:Cipfried} in the temple for healing.
Mission 1 (A Taste of Things to Come) no longer exists for new characters — you start here, after arriving from Dawnport. See the notes at the end of the guide.

Go to the **Rookgaard Academy** and talk to {npc:Vascalir}. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and accept with {key:yes}. When he finishes explaining about the catapults, confirm again with {key:yes}. The barn is marked on your map.
Get a stone from the barn

Go to the barn just **north of {npc:Tom}'s shop** (a few steps northwest of the academy). Go down the stairs to the cellar, where there are piles of stones. Use a pile of stones to pick up a {item:Heavy Stone}.
The stones are very heavy: free up capacity in your inventory before picking them up.

Take the stone to one of the catapults and use the {item:Heavy Stone} on the catapult. There are four catapults: one on **{npc:Norma}'s roof**, one on **{npc:Obi}'s roof** and **two on the academy roof**. Each loaded catapult gives **5 experience** and can only be loaded once.
You can't use two stones in a row: load one, go back to the barn and get another.

Go back to the barn cellar, pick up another stone and load a different catapult. According to the spoiler, **two** loaded catapults are enough to finish; {npc:Vascalir} talks about all four, so if he doesn't accept, load the rest the same way.
Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes} when he asks whether you loaded the catapults. You receive a {item:Studded Shield}.

Keep talking to {npc:Vascalir}. He asks if you have fought before: answer {key:no} (to hear the explanation) and then {key:yes} twice. The mission is to kill **5 {creature:Rat|Rats}** in the sewers. He marks two sewers with rats on your map.
Vascalir warns: once you reach level 9 you can no longer continue this quest. Don't hunt more than necessary.

The nearest sewer grate is in the **centre of the village, just south of the academy**. Go down and kill 5 {creature:Rat|Rats}. Check the quest log to see how many you have killed. You don't need to take the corpses. To leave, go back to where you came down and climb the stairs beneath the grate.
If you get low on health, switch on defensive mode (shield icon) and leave the sewer.
Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and say {key:yes} when he asks if you have killed the 5 rats. You receive a {item:Sabre}. He tells you to talk to {npc:Lily}, to the southwest.

From the temple, follow the road **southwest** to {npc:Lily}'s shop. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. She gives you a bag of herbs to deliver to the old alchemist {npc:Hyacinth} and marks the ramp on your map.

Leave the village by the bridge to the **north**. After crossing, follow the dirt path **east** until you reach a rocky mountain. Walk around the mountain until you find a ramp inside it and climb up to {npc:Hyacinth}'s laboratory, at the top.
North bridge of the village (guard Dallheim)
Don't stray from the path: there are dangerous monsters around the island.

Say {key:hi} and {key:herbs} to {npc:Hyacinth}; he takes the herbs from your inventory. Answer {key:yes} to receive **2 {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions}** and {key:yes} again (if you have space) to receive a {item:Star Ring}. The ring improves health regeneration while you have no vocation.

Before you leave, search the box behind {npc:Hyacinth}: it has **5 {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms}**. Then go down the mountain ramp and return to the village the same way (dirt path **west** and the north bridge). Talk to {npc:Vascalir}.

Say {key:hi} and {key:help} (or {key:mission}) to {npc:Vascalir} and accept with {key:yes}. He wants a sample of the web of the {creature:Spider Queen}, a giant tarantula that lives underground. She is too strong for you, but she is almost blind and hunts by smell.
Leave the village via the **north**, head **northwest** and cross the bridge to the west. The lair is marked on your minimap. Go in and keep going down until you see some **blue stones**.
Use one of the blue stones: you rub the grease on your body and become temporarily {wiki:Invisibility|invisible} to the queen. From this moment you have **2 minutes**.
The {creature:Spider Queen} is too strong for you: do not attack her.

Find an intact spider web and use it. There is one very close to the stairs, on the wall slightly to the **west**. Then leave the lair before the 2 minutes run out, going up the stairs you came down. The silk does not appear in your inventory (it is not an item).

If you don't get out in time, the queen catches you and takes you to a giant web. Free yourself by walking (very slowly) to the hole just to the **south** and repeat everything: use the blue stone and the web again.

Return to the village the same way (bridge to the east, then southeast to the north bridge) and talk to {npc:Vascalir}: answer {key:yes}. You receive a {item:Studded Armor}. He sends you to talk to {npc:Tom}, the tanner, about the boots.
Go to {npc:Tom}'s shop and say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. He wants {creature:War Wolf} pelt and talks about a poacher who went into the wolf den. The den is marked on the map.
Leave the village via the north and head **northeast** to the {creature:Wolf|wolves}' den. Go into the cave and search the dead human (the poacher): you find a skinning knife.
Go further into the cave and skin the dead {creature:War Wolf}. You will hear wolves in the distance.
Run **east** to the ramp before time runs out. You get a lot of extra speed (as if you had 90 more levels). You never actually see the wolves: it is just a time limit.
If you fail, you can try running again without any penalty.
Pick up the potion on floor -2
Don't forget the box on floor **-2** of this cave: it has a {item:Small Health Potion}.
Return to the surface via the stairs and ramps you came by and go back to the village to the **southwest**, entering via the north bridge.
Go back to {npc:Tom} and answer {key:yes}. The pelt is ruined, so he gives you some ordinary {item:Leather Boots}. Then go back to {npc:Vascalir}.
Talk to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes} twice. The trolls got into the library vault through a tunnel and set it on fire. You have to save the **Book of Orc Language**.
Go down the stairs in the **north** part of the academy to the Library Vault. Go through the quest door (red handle) and go down the stairs.
The vault is on fire: don't step on the fire fields, they deal damage.
Put out the fire and open the chest

Head **northwest**. On a table there is a {item:Destroy Field Rune} (unlimited uses): use it on the fire field blocking you to reach the blue chest. Open the chest to get the {item:Book of Orc Language}.

Go back up the same stairs to the academy and talk to {npc:Vascalir}: answer {key:yes}. You receive **100 experience and 100 gold**. When he asks whether you are ready for the next mission, answer {key:yes}.

{npc:Vascalir} sends you to the bank. Go down to the floor beneath the academy and talk to {npc:Paulie}. Say {key:hi}, {key:deposit all} and {key:yes} (you can deposit any amount). The first time, he adds a **50 gold** bonus to your balance.
Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and ask about the mission ({key:mission}).
Answer {key:yes} to {npc:Vascalir}. You have to find the trolls' tunnel in the ruins to the north and make it collapse.
Go to the troll cave in the **ruins north of the village**. Inside, follow the path that goes **west** (it is the freshly dug tunnel). You will face {creature:Young Troll|Young Trolls}.
Bring food and a potion. If you need to buy something, withdraw money from the bank.
Go down **two floors**. Open the chests to get a {item:Pick} and some {item:Leather Legs}.
Use the {item:Pick} on each of the **five wooden beams**. They are all in this same room.
Leave and let the tunnel collapse

When all five beams are weakened, leave the cave. As soon as you go up a floor, the cave below collapses. Keep going up the same way to the surface and return to the village to the **south**, entering via the north bridge.
Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes}. You receive **50 experience** and a {item:Brass Helmet}.
Say {key:hi} to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes}. He wants a meaty bone from the cemetery crypt and gives you a {item:Garlic Necklace} to protect you from the life drain of the undead. Equip it.
Leave Rookgaard via the **north** bridge and head **southeast** to the cemetery (east of the village). The stairs to the dungeon are inside the building: go down.
The cemetery is cursed: there are {creature:Skeleton|Skeletons} wandering around.

Down there, head **northeast**, go in through the quest door and search a {item:Sarcophagus} (like those in the Ankrahmun Tombs) until you find the {item:Fleshy Bone}. Then go up the same stairs in the cemetery building and return to the village the same way (**northwest** to the north bridge).
In another coffin along the way there is a {item:Small Health Potion}, and in a box near the ramp there are 5 {item:Brown Mushroom|Brown Mushrooms}.
Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes} twice. You receive **150 experience** and a {item:Sword}.
Say {key:hi} to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes} twice. He gives you a {item:Silver Amulet} (protects against poison) and an empty flask to collect wasp poison.

Leave again via the **north** bridge. Go to the part **west of the river** and go down the ramp to the **south**. Follow the road **west** until you see a tower: it is the {wiki:Wasp Tower|Wasp Tower}, full of {creature:Wasp|Wasps}.
The wasps poison you: use the {item:Silver Amulet}.

Kill a {creature:Wasp} and use the flask Vascalir gave you on its corpse, right after it dies. Then return to the village the same way: road to the **east**, go up the ramp and cross the north bridge.
Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes}. You receive an {item:Antidote Potion}; answer {key:yes} again to receive a {item:Brass Shield}. You also gain **150 experience**.
Antidote Potion, Brass Shield and 150 experience
Say {key:hi} to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes}. He explains the plan for getting into the orc fortress.

Go down to the academy cellar, next to the bank ({npc:Paulie}), turn right and open the big blue chest. You receive a bag with: a {item:Rolling Pin (Rookgaard)|rolling pin}, a {item:Fleshy Bone}, the wasp poison and a {item:Tarantula Trap}.

Go to the orc fortress, very close to the {wiki:Wasp Tower|Wasp Tower} (the way is the same as in the previous mission and is marked on the map). You can't enter without a disguise. Go around the fortress to the back until you find the {creature:Peeing Orc}. Use the rolling pin on him to steal his disguise.
Enter through the **front** of the fortress before the disguise runs out.
The disguise lasts only a short time: go straight to the entrance.

Inside, head **north** until you find an {creature:Elite Orc Guard}. Use the {item:Fleshy Bone} on him: several {creature:Wild Dog|Wild Dogs} appear and the guard runs off after them. Go down the stairs he was guarding.
In the orc dungeon, find the kitchen with {creature:Kraknaknork}'s cauldron and use the flask of wasp poison on the cauldron. This step is **mandatory**: it weakens the boss.
Pick up the eggs and potions
Open the blue chest to get **30 {item:Egg|Eggs}**. Also open the chest to the **southwest of the kitchen** to get **2 more {item:Small Health Potion|Small Health Potions}**.

Further on there is another orc guarding the portal to Kraknaknork's room. Lure him first to the **other side of the room** and then use the {item:Tarantula Trap} (the spider web) on him to paralyse him. Run and enter the teleport.
Open the way with the levers

In {creature:Kraknaknork}'s lair, use the levers to open the way to the teleport. Enter the room with the blue chest and pick up the last {item:Small Health Potion} (you should have 7 by now). If the wall reappears, don't panic: just walk through it.
Put the potions on a hotkey and kill {creature:Kraknaknork}. Even weakened, he hits hard.
If you die here you don't lose equipment or experience (the floor is special). Go back and try again.
After Kraknaknork dies, enter the teleport to collect the final rewards.

The wiki does not describe the exit from the rewards room: go back along the orc dungeon path to the stairs the {creature:Elite Orc Guard} was guarding, go up and leave the fortress through the front. Then return to the village the same way as from the Wasp Tower (road to the **east**, ramp and north bridge).

Go back to {npc:Vascalir} and answer {key:yes} when he asks whether you killed Kraknaknork. The quest is complete. He advises you to reach level 8, talk to the oracle above the academy and travel to the Isle of Destiny to choose your vocation.

**Mission 1 (A Taste of Things to Come)** only existed for old characters: after the {wiki:The Beginning Quest|The Beginning Quest}, when crossing the bridge you were teleported to {wiki:Kraknaknork's Dimension|Kraknaknork's dimension}, killed by a demon and woke up next to {npc:Asralius}, who gave your experience back. In the blue chest you received a {item:Backpack} with a {item:Wooden Sword} and a {item:Torch}.
Since Update 10.55 (arrival of Dawnport) Mission 1 is impossible for new characters, so the {item:Wooden Sword} can no longer be obtained and has become a collector's item.
The Spider Queen's silk is not an item: it doesn't appear in your inventory. Vascalir keeps the items you bring him throughout the missions and gives them back to you in the blue chest of Mission 12.
